title: An etale-local ideal divides an ideal extended from the base
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings for which $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $a\in A$ be a nonzerodivisor (multiplication by $a$ on $A$ is injective), and let $J\subset B$ be a finitely generated ideal such that $V(J)\subset V(aB)$, where $V$ denotes the set of primes containing the indicated ideal. For every prime $\mathfrak q\subset B$ there exist a finitely generated ideal $I\subset A$, an element $g\in B\setminus\mathfrak q$, and a finitely generated ideal $J'\subset B_g$ such that $V(I)\subset V(a)$ and $IB_g=(JB_g)J'$. Here $B_g$ is the localization obtained by inverting $g$, and $IB_g$ and $JB_g$ are the ideals generated by the images of $I$ and $J$.

source.place: Tag 0813, lemma-push-ideal; the affine etale convention is supplied by the existing lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-zero-locus-eq-iff-radical-eq], $\sqrt J$ is the intersection of the prime ideals containing $J$. Every such prime contains the image $a_B$ of $a$, since $V(J)\subset V(aB)$. Thus $a_B\in\sqrt J$, and the definition of the radical in that same statement gives an integer $m\ge1$ with $a_B^m\in J$. Fix this exponent before any localization.

source.place: Tag 0813 (lemma-push-ideal), proof: the zero-locus condition signifies that a power of a belongs to J; 00E0(7) supplies the radical criterion

proof.text: Fix $\mathfrak q\subset B$ and choose a finite generating list for $J$. Apply [lem-trf-etale-chart-ideal-lift] with the exponent $m$ of Step 1. It supplies $g\notin\mathfrak q$, $C=A[T]/(f)$ with a basis of $d$ elements, $h\in C$, an $A$-algebra isomorphism $\theta:B_g\cong C_h$, and a finitely generated ideal $K\subset C$ with $KC_h=\theta(JB_g)$ and $a_C^m(C/K)=0$. It also supplies etaleness of $\operatorname{Spec}C_h\to\operatorname{Spec}A$.

source.place: Tag 0813, lemma-push-ideal, proof; Tag 0812, lemma-trick-fitting-ideal for the factorization.

proof.text: Use that basis to form $\pi:A^{\oplus d}\cong C\twoheadrightarrow C/K$ and put $I=I_0(\pi)$. The chart supplies finite freeness of $C$, etaleness of $C_h$ over $A$, and finite generation of $K$, so [lem-trf-etale-fitting-trick] applies to this chosen $\pi$. It gives $I$ finitely generated and $L=(\ell_1,\ldots,\ell_s)\subset C_h$ with $IC_h=(KC_h)L$. Set $J'=\theta^{-1}(L)$. If $\theta(x)=\sum u_i\ell_i$, then $x=\sum\theta^{-1}(u_i)\theta^{-1}(\ell_i)$, so $J'$ is generated by the $\theta^{-1}(\ell_i)$. As $\theta$ fixes images of $A$, it sends $IB_g$ to $IC_h$; it sends $(JB_g)J'$ to $(KC_h)L$. Its injectivity therefore gives $IB_g=(JB_g)J'$.

source.place: Tag 0813, lemma-push-ideal, proof; Tag 0812, lemma-trick-fitting-ideal for the factorization.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-free-quotient-fitting-power] to the same $\pi:A^{\oplus d}\twoheadrightarrow M=C/K$ and $b=a^m$. On $M$, scalar multiplication by $b$ is multiplication by $a_C^m$, which vanishes by Step 2. The cited statement gives $(a^m)^d=a^{md}\in I$ and $V(I)\subset V(a)$, since $m\ge1$. This includes $d=0$, when $I=A$ and its zero locus is empty. Step 3 supplies finite generation and the ideal equality, while Step 2 gives $g\notin\mathfrak q$.

source.place: Tag 0813, lemma-push-ideal, proof; Tag 0812, lemma-trick-fitting-ideal for the factorization.

lean.statement: theorem exists_fg_ideal_local_factor (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) [AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))] (a : A) (ha : Function.Injective (fun x : A => a * x)) (J : Ideal B) (hJ : J.FG) (hV : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B) ⊆ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map φ (Ideal.span ({a} : Set A)) : Set B)) (q : PrimeSpectrum B) : ∃ (I : Ideal A) (g : B), I.FG ∧ g ∉ q.asIdeal ∧ ∃ (J' : Ideal (Localization.Away g)), J'.FG ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ⊆ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.span ({a} : Set A) : Set A) ∧ Ideal.map ((algebraMap B (Localization.Away g)).comp φ) I = Ideal.map (algebraMap B (Localization.Away g)) J * J'
